rules.prefer: Value computed by shared helpers (FUN_180cb0be0 / FUN_1802cc6e0) together with a few other Synchro dragons; returns 0 if not applicable

notes: No logic specific to Crystal Wing's negate or battle ATK gain; probably generic negate handling.

name: Sky Striker Mecha - Shark Cannon

rules.when: Sky Striker 'no monsters in Main Monster Zone' Spell
rules.prefer: Only activates when every monster it controls is in an Extra Monster Zone

rules.when: Deciding whether to activate Shark Cannon
rules.prefer: Holds it unless it has at least 3 Spells in its GY (so it can Special Summon the target instead of just banishing)

rules.when: Opponent has a specific Spell/Trap (MD 0x159d) on their field but does not control MD 0x158b
rules.prefer: Does not activate (likely a GY-lock card)

notes: FUN_180095880 read as 'Spells in GY' from the >=3 threshold. MD 0x159d/0x158b not in pool.

name: Sky Striker Mecha - Hornet Drones

rules.when: Resolving Sky Striker Mobilize - Engage! (search) with Hornet Drones in the Deck, Sky Striker Ace - Kagari in hand and usable, and Raye either not in the Deck or already held
rules.prefer: Searches Hornet Drones; otherwise defaults to searching Sky Striker Ace - Raye

notes: Kagari/Raye location helpers (FUN_1806609e0, FUN_18006c7c0, FUN_1807c3520) inferred as in-hand/usable/held checks.

name: Cyberse Wicckid

rules.when: Judging whether a Link Summon of Cyberse Wicckid is worthwhile
rules.prefer: Count it worthwhile only if a lookahead, assuming a monster gets Special Summoned to a zone it points to, shows both parts of its search effect resolve (a Cyberse to banish from the GY and a Cyberse Tuner to add from the Deck)

notes: Two extra guards (local flags) must also hold; they look like 'summon is legal' and 'follow-up possible' but are not confirmed.

name: Incredible Ecclesia, the Virtuous

rules.when: Shared branch with Blazing Cartesia (and MD 18533)
rules.prefer: Generic handling; mapped to internal code MD 16029.

notes: No Ecclesia-specific condition.

name: Heavy Polymerization

rules.when: Checking whether Heavy Polymerization can make a Fusion Summon
rules.prefer: Only consider it usable when at least 3 materials are available (hand/field plus Extra Deck monsters it may banish), even if the target Fusion Monster needs fewer

notes: Shared with MD id 0x3e53 (another 3+ material fusion spell). The added count term appears to be the extra 'banish from Extra Deck' material pool; exact source not verified.

name: Dark Magician of Destruction

rules.when: A Spell Card/effect is activated
rules.prefer: Records a marker for this card so its alternative summon (needs a Spell activated this turn) is known to be available

notes: Event class 8 read as 'Spell activation'; marker is registered for player 0 only. Gated on a newer card id existing (version check).

name: Salamangreat Almiraj

rules.when: Battle forecast: a monster that was Normal Summoned/Set would be destroyed by battle and its controller has Almiraj in the GY
rules.prefer: Expects Almiraj to be Special Summoned, so counts the battle as giving the defender a follow-up

rules.when: Almiraj's Tribute protection effect on the chain
rules.prefer: Classified in a shared effect-category branch (generic protection handling)

notes: Zone flag 0x10000 interpreted as 'was Normal Summoned/Set'. No special rule for when to tribute Almiraj for protection.

name: Dogmatika Ecclesia, the Virtuous

rules.when: Selecting the Dogmatika card to add
rules.prefer: Shared generic handling

notes: Only group membership.

name: Psychic End Punisher

rules.when: Battle-stat simulation outside the battle step, when LP differ and its start-of-Battle-Phase boost has not been applied yet
rules.prefer: Assume it gains ATK equal to the LP difference, register that as a planned activation, and mark it applied

rules.when: Its effect is checked by the targeting/activation callback
rules.prefer: Only proceed if an unknown precondition (FUN_18098eb70) holds

notes: The simulation briefly shifts LP by 1000 to test a condition, then restores it. Probably this is the LP-cost or unaffected-while-lower check; uncertain. No banish-target preference was found.

name: Aluber the Jester of Despia

rules.when: Battle forecast: a Fusion Monster that matches Aluber's trigger would be destroyed by battle, its controller has Aluber in the GY, and there is at least one Effect Monster Aluber could target
rules.prefer: Expects Aluber to revive and negate a monster, so counts the battle as giving the defender a follow-up (attack is less attractive)

rules.when: Evaluating Aluber's GY effect on the chain against a specific monster
rules.prefer: Scores it in the same 'negate this monster's effects until end of turn' threat group as Effect Veiler

rules.when: Choosing the monster to negate with Aluber's revive effect
rules.prefer: Uses a precomputed choice from the CPU's plan data when one exists (exact criterion not readable)

notes: Battle-forecast branch checks the trigger filter for Aluber and that Aluber has legal targets, then that Aluber is in the GY (FUN_1807c3520 assumed GY lookup). The search-on-summon effect has no special handling. FUN_180c0e9e0 (5202 case) and FUN_180989230/FUN_1804759b0 are unidentified.

name: Sky Striker Ace - Camellia

rules.when: Appears in shared card-id tables
rules.prefer: Handled by shared branches with other cards

notes: No Camellia-specific condition visible.

name: Sky Striker Mobilize - Engage!

rules.when: Resolving Engage!: choosing the Sky Striker card to add
rules.prefer: Search Hornet Drones if it is in the Deck, Kagari is in the Extra Deck and summonable, and Raye is unavailable or already in hand. Otherwise, if no earlier rule fired, search Raye.

notes: The Kagari helper meanings are inferred. When the local counter is positive, the code falls through to a generic selection instead. Activation timing for Engage is not in the evidence.

name: Sky Striker Ace - Kagari

rules.when: Resolving Sky Striker Mobilize - Engage!'s search while Hornet Drones is a choice, Kagari is in the Extra Deck and can be Special Summoned, and Raye is not offered or already in the GY
rules.prefer: Searches Hornet Drones; otherwise falls back to searching Raye

notes: Kagari only appears as a condition in Engage!'s search choice. No logic for Kagari's own add-Spell effect found.

name: Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy

rules.when: Resolving its ATK-gain effect after face-up Xyz Monsters were destroyed
rules.prefer: Use the highest original ATK among the destroyed monsters as the gain

rules.when: Forecasting a board where a face-up Xyz Monster with positive ATK is destroyed while a Titanic Galaxy that can use its effect is on the same side
rules.prefer: Add the destroyed monster's original ATK to the predicted ATK of the Xyz Monsters that would gain it

rules.when: Rating an opponent's face-up Titanic Galaxy
rules.prefer: Rate it as an active threat only while its effect can still be activated

notes: No specific handling found for its Spell-negate or attack-redirect effects. Their handling may sit in shared branches (FUN_180698a80:5551 with 0x2ff0, and FUN_180b23d50:6502 with 0x2ff8, 0x2d82 and 0x2f81), which are unread. FUN_18015b950 is assumed to mean 'is an Xyz Monster'.

name: Witchcrafter Genni

rules.when: Selecting a card for Genni's effect (FUN_180aa5c00 handler)
rules.prefer: If the selection context has flag 0x20000000 set, take the first offered candidate; otherwise use the default choice.

notes: Other references are switch cases that jump to branches shared with other cards (MD 14896, 15443, 16202). The meaning of flag 0x20000000 in this context is unknown.

name: Crossout Designator

rules.when: The opponent activates a card or effect and the CPU's Main Deck still holds a card with the same original name
rules.prefer: Chain Crossout Designator and declare that card's name, so the opponent's copy is negated

notes: FUN_180ca7160 is read as the chain-response evaluator: param_2 is the opposing chain link, and its card's name is matched against the declarable options. FUN_1809e49b0 is a generic list. Main Phase proactive use (declaring a known hand trap in advance) was not found.

name: Number 60: Dugares the Timeless

rules.when: Choosing Dugares's mode
rules.prefer: Mapped to internal effect code 0x417 in a big shared switch; no visible mode-choice logic.

notes: The shared branch's behaviour is not visible in the snippet.

name: Fallen of Albaz

rules.when: Fallen of Albaz is the card involved in the triggering event, and the CPU has certain Albaz-related support cards (MD 16016/16029/16030/16244) whose relevant once-per-turn effect is unused and not already planned
rules.prefer: Activates that support card when a count check (> 6, likely cards in Deck) and an unidentified readiness check pass

notes: Rule belongs to Albaz-related support cards whose identities are not in the pool map.

name: Dogmatika Fleurdelis, the Knighted

rules.when: Fleurdelis's effect is on the chain or being evaluated
rules.prefer: Handled in shared branches with other Dogmatika cards and other monster-negation effects: the affected monster is read through a common helper and scored as a 'negate a monster' threat

rules.when: Dogmatika family planning branch (cards 0x3af9-0x3b8a share it)
rules.prefer: Only Fleurdelis takes a special path when paired with another specific Dogmatika card (MD 0x3b89): it checks an effect-availability condition before planning

notes: MD 0x3b89 is not in the pool (likely another Dogmatika card). No card-specific condition for when to Special Summon from hand or use the +500 ATK effect was found.

name: Lubellion the Searing Dragon

rules.when: Card-id remapping table
rules.prefer: Lubellion is mapped to another id (MD 13186) in a lookup helper

notes: Purpose of the remap unknown.

name: Despian Quaeritis

rules.when: Considering the Main Phase quick effect (ATK of all non-Lv8+ Fusion monsters becomes 0)
rules.prefer: Simulates the board with the ATK change applied and only activates if the simulated outcome scores positive; otherwise holds

rules.when: Answering Quaeritis' option prompt (likely add-to-hand vs Special Summon on the leave-field trigger)
rules.prefer: Shared rule that accepts only the first option variant

notes: FUN_180c33d30 assumed to be a board evaluation; an extra zone-mask condition before the simulation is not fully readable. Prompt rule is a shared branch.

rules.when: Its selections
rules.prefer: Use the default selection scorer (FUN_180abc9d0) shared with many cards

name: Black Rose Dragon

rules.when: An effect lets the CPU pick a Synchro monster from a list (resolver group that includes MD 14614/12754/13166/15325)
rules.prefer: Fixed preference order: four unknown older Synchros, then T.G. Hyper Librarian, then one unknown, then Black Rose Dragon, then Stardust Dragon, then the rest.

rules.when: A play is being judged while Black Rose Dragon is in the acting player's Extra Deck (own, or the opponent's if revealed) and a summon option is pending
rules.prefer: Run a main-phase lookahead. If the best follow-up is activating Black Rose Dragon, the check fails and the play is held back. If the opponent's field value is low or no lookahead is possible, the check passes.

rules.when: Considering Black Rose Dragon's effect (likely the destroy-all trigger)
rules.prefer: Simulate the opponent's chain response first. If they would respond, do not activate.

notes: The pick-order list in FUN_180ad97c0 is certain; which effects use it is not (those resolver IDs are not in the pool). The FUN_180e3bee0 return semantics are inferred: false only when the lookahead's top action is BRD. In FUN_180679720 BRD maps to class value 2, meaning unknown. FUN_1809e7870 pairs BRD with card MD 14192.

name: Invocation

rules.when: Effect classification
rules.prefer: Falls in a large default range of a switch (no card-specific logic)

notes: No material-choice logic found here.

rules.when: Effect property lookup table
rules.prefer: Grouped with other Sky Striker cards; no specific condition

name: Invoked Mechaba

rules.when: Big shared switch
rules.prefer: Generic.

notes: Bare case label only; the negate logic is not visible.

name: Gold Sarcophagus

rules.when: Picking a card by name from a priority list while Gold Sarcophagus (or one of two similar delayed-add cards) exists and the player has banished cards
rules.prefer: Skip a card whose same-name copy is already banished face-up awaiting return by Gold Sarcophagus; do not pick a duplicate of a card already on its way

notes: Helper is a 'find card X in the current selection list' wrapper used by priority lists in the big selection routine FUN_180ad97c0. The two sibling cards are MD ids 0x2477 and 0x2ce9. Location code 0x11 on the tracked card is assumed to be banished.

name: Witch of the Black Forest

rules.when: Choosing a card for a selection of a particular kind (flag bits suggest a send/tribute-type choice)
rules.prefer: Pick from a fixed priority list: three other floater cards first, then Witch of the Black Forest, since it searches when sent from the field

notes: Shared 4-card list (MD ids 0xd7a, 0xd7c, 0xfd6, then Witch). Selection-kind flag meaning unknown, so 'cost/tribute' is an inference from the card text.

name: Foolish Burial

rules.when: Building a plan and fewer than 2 Foolish Burials have been used (fewer than 1 on the Light CPU setting)
rules.prefer: Run a lookahead of Foolish Burial and count the monsters it would send as reachable resources

rules.when: Picking which monster to send from the Deck
rules.prefer: Use the generic best-card-to-mill evaluator (it is also called when another card, MD 0x1ce0, checks what Foolish Burial would mill)

notes: The count helper FUN_18000c020(p,GY,id) may count Foolish Burials in the GY rather than uses this turn. FUN_180aa5c00 and FUN_180ad97c0 send it into branches shared with 0x1f99, 0x1f5b and 0xd95 that were not read.

name: Dimensional Fissure

rules.when: The CPU's effect planner looks at this card
rules.prefer: No special handling; it falls into a large block of card ids the planner skips

notes: Only appears as one label in a long run of consecutive case ids that just break out of the switch. Treat it with default AI logic.

name: Lunalight Tiger

rules.when: Battle forecast with Lunalight Tiger as a battling monster
rules.prefer: Checks for its on-destruction revive and flags the battle as having a follow-up for Tiger's controller

rules.when: Tiger's effects on the chain
rules.prefer: Separates its monster effect from its Pendulum effect by effect index

notes: FUN_18089c910 not identified; reading it as 'revive available' is an inference.

name: Primathmech Alembertian

rules.when: Detaching materials for its on-Xyz-Summon effect (choice of 2/3/4)
rules.prefer: The selection handler returns 'yes' only when the current option count is 3, i.e. it prefers detaching 3 to search a Level 4 monster.

notes: The handler returns (value == 3). Whether the value is the detach count or an option index is uncertain.

name: Accesscode Talker

rules.when: Choosing a Link Monster to banish / card to destroy for Accesscode's effect
rules.prefer: Uses a dedicated selection routine unless a selection-context flag is set, in which case it gives no preference

rules.when: Accesscode's destroy effect on the chain
rules.prefer: Affected card read through the shared destroy/negate helper

notes: The dedicated routine (LAB_180ab28e0) was not decompiled here, so the actual preference is unknown.

name: Fairy Tail - Luna

rules.when: Considering Luna's Quick Effect
rules.prefer: Activate only if a chain lookahead of the effect returns a positive result

rules.when: Checking a candidate for the bounce effect
rules.prefer: Accept the choice only when the effect would touch exactly 2 cards (Luna plus the target); other modes pass by default

notes: The 'exactly 2 cards' reading comes from a bit count of a lookahead mask, and only applies when a field equals 3 (assumed to be the effect index or phase). The search effect on Normal Summon has no special handling.

name: Ravenous Crocodragon Archethys

rules.when: Forecasting a battle against an opponent who has a face-up, non-negated Archethys
rules.prefer: Treat Archethys as a monster whose Quick Effect can interfere, which changes the forecast result

notes: Archethys is in a shared list of about 9 monsters with quick removal/negation effects (one of them, 0x3f11, has extra conditions; Archethys has none). The surrounding forecast also involves hand card 0x2b2d. Exact effect on the forecast (local flag set to 2) is unclear.

name: Tri-Brigade Fraktall

rules.when: Its Deck-to-GY effect resolves (effect flag 0x800) and card MD 0x3d55 is selectable
rules.prefer: Send MD 0x3d55 if its 'value when sent to GY' score is above 30012 (i.e. it has a live GY effect); otherwise use the generic choice

notes: MD 0x3d55 is not in the pool; it is probably a Tri-Brigade monster with a GY trigger. FUN_18093bf00 maps Fraktall to archetype code 0x3c7d (generic). The 6721 case is a shared group that uses the default selection scorer. No Link-summon choice logic was found.

name: Albion the Branded Dragon

rules.when: End Phase GY trigger (add or Set a Branded Spell/Trap) is available, unused this turn and not already planned
rules.prefer: Simulates the search and activates if it succeeds; chooses between adding and Setting from a lookahead mode flag

notes: Effect index 2 assumed to be the End Phase GY effect. The add-vs-Set choice derives from two unidentified helpers.

rules.when: Effect classification table
rules.prefer: Shared branch; no specific condition

name: Divine Arsenal AA-ZEUS - Sky Thunder

rules.when: The alternative Xyz Summon onto 1 Xyz Monster is available
rules.prefer: Plan the summon. Candidate materials are the zones of Xyz monsters eligible for the overlay.

rules.when: Choosing the Xyz monster for ZEUS's alternative summon
rules.prefer: Exclude monsters that are not Xyz or have no materials attached; only overlay an Xyz monster that has at least 1 material.

rules.when: ZEUS is face-up and has 2+ materials
rules.prefer: Mark its send-all quick effect as an activation candidate, with higher priority when the evaluation's extra argument is positive.

notes: FUN_1809a0120 is read as the material count and FUN_18015b950 as 'is Xyz'. The activation rule also needs the evaluator's own flags (param_10 slots); their exact meaning is unclear.

name: Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir

rules.when: Deciding how to handle Bagooska depending on whose turn it is
rules.prefer: On its controller's own turn it takes a default path; on the opponent's turn it goes to a separate check (likely keeping it in Defense Position)

notes: Role of FUN_18080ea60 unclear (possibly position/target value); pairs Bagooska with MD 0x3646.

name: T.G. Hyper Librarian

rules.when: An effect lets the CPU pick a Synchro monster from a list (same priority list as Black Rose Dragon)
rules.prefer: Rank Hyper Librarian 5th, ahead of Black Rose Dragon and Stardust Dragon.

rules.when: Evaluating summon actions while the CPU controls 3+ monsters
rules.prefer: Normally pass actions to the follow-up evaluator. If Hyper Librarian is already on the field, skip actions of category 5 (probably further Synchro plays) unless the action is Hyper Librarian itself and a flag is set.

notes: The direction of the FUN_1809d0600 rule depends on what FUN_1809ce600 does, which is unknown. Action category 5 is also unidentified.

name: Golden Cloud Beast - Malong

rules.when: Valuing Malong as it is sent to the GY (material or cost) while its once-per-turn GY bounce is unused
rules.prefer: Score it as good to send to the GY

rules.when: Its Level-change on Special Summon is being resolved and a planning flag is on
rules.prefer: Call a level-planning routine to pick +1 or -1 (probably toward an available Synchro or Xyz Level)

notes: FUN_180a0d6b0 (the level planner) was not analysed.

name: Relinquished Anima

rules.when: Choosing the zone to Link Summon Relinquished Anima
rules.prefer: Scores zones that point at opponent monsters by that monster's ATK (ATK/50) rather than a flat value, so it points at the opponent's highest-ATK equippable monster

rules.when: Shared check that a pointed monster can be used by its effect
rules.prefer: Generic

notes: Other Link Monsters get a flat +10 per usable pointed opponent monster in the same loop.

rules.when: Shared branch with Incredible Ecclesia (and MD 18533)
rules.prefer: Generic; mapped to internal code MD 16029.

name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Tiger King

rules.when: Card MD 10630 (likely a Fire Fist/Fire Formation card) weighs a Beast-Warrior on the field
rules.prefer: Tiger King (and MD 10645) count with weight 2 instead of 1.

rules.when: Listed in several shared card-ID switches
rules.prefer: Same as the other cards in that branch; nothing specific to Tiger King.

notes: No condition specific to its negate or recruit effects is visible. FUN_180698a80 sets a flag and calls FUN_180050440 on Tiger King; purpose unknown.

name: Swordsoul Supreme Sovereign - Chengying

rules.when: Shared activation-check branch with MD 16517
rules.prefer: Handled generically

notes: No specific rule visible.

name: Preparation of Rites

rules.when: Choosing which Ritual Monster to add (shared Ritual-searcher branch)
rules.prefer: Prefer a candidate that would be immediately activatable or usable from hand (playable-after-add scorer); otherwise use the default scorer

rules.when: Scoring candidates when a Ritual Monster is among them and the CPU holds Preparation of Rites whose first part can resolve but whose second part (Ritual Spell from GY) has nothing to take
rules.prefer: Give that candidate a very high score (at least 200000)

notes: FUN_180aba710 is a candidate scorer that returns 200000+. The CPU-side list it scans (+0x516e) is assumed to be the hand. The two lookahead calls (option 0 / option 1) are read as the card's two parts; uncertain.

name: Effect Veiler

rules.when: The opponent activates Effect Veiler and the CPU has a legal response that passed its earlier checks
rules.prefer: Always rates responding to Veiler as worthwhile (fixed 'yes' tier)

rules.when: Resolving a specific search effect (MD 0x2005) while the CPU's deck plan flag 0x244d is set
rules.prefer: Picks MD 0x2501 if offered, otherwise Effect Veiler

rules.when: Veiler's effect on the chain
rules.prefer: Scored as a 'negate this monster until end of turn' threat via the card's category lookup

notes: 0x10000000 is one of several nonzero 'respond' tiers in the response evaluator (0 = don't). MD 0x2005/0x2501/0x244d are outside the pool. No logic about when the CPU itself activates Veiler beyond generic handling.

rules.when: Shared branches (with MD 14950; MD 5501/5698)
rules.prefer: Generic handling of its destroy-target effect; nothing specific visible.

name: Griffoh

rules.when: Checking whether a face-down Quick-Play Spell can be activated the turn it was Set
rules.prefer: Treat it as activatable when it was Set by Griffoh (or one of four other cards that Set a Quick-Play usable this turn)

notes: Shared 5-card list (0x377d, 0x3a39, 0x49a9, Griffoh 0x59a9, 0x5b69) with a fallback check. Called from two board-evaluation routines on set cards with the Quick-Play icon. No logic for Griffoh's damage-to-0 mode or its Ritual tribute ability was found.

name: Magicians' Souls

rules.when: Building the card list for its effect index 2
rules.prefer: Add this card itself to the list (with card MD 0x2fc1 handled the same way)

notes: This is probably bookkeeping for the 'send this card to the GY' option rather than a strategic preference.

name: Sky Striker Mecha - Widow Anchor

rules.when: Deciding whether to activate Widow Anchor
rules.prefer: Holds it unless it has at least 3 Spells in its GY (so it can take control of the target as well as negate it)

notes: Same 'Spells in GY >= 3' check as Shark Cannon. The 'no monsters in Main Monster Zone' legality check is elsewhere.

name: Sky Striker Ace - Azalea

rules.when: Evaluating Azalea's Special Summon destroy effect (on either side)
rules.prefer: Count it as usable only if a chain lookahead confirms it resolves (there is a destroyable target)

rules.when: The CPU's effect planner handles a summoned Azalea
rules.prefer: Mark its zone with a priority level of 3, similar to other self-removing or destroy effects

notes: FUN_180891df0 appears to judge whether a card's effect is live (it also models opponent threats). At 2505, Azalea shares a branch with 0x4ddd. The meaning of the planner's mark via FUN_18063b500(zone,3,2) is unknown. No logic found for its battle-destroy effect or for Spell counts.

name: Wind Pegasus @Ignister

rules.when: Wind Pegasus is present (helper FUN_1807c3520 finds it) and a location lookup puts it in one of the thinking player's zones that passes an availability check
rules.prefer: Register that zone/card in a planning list (possibly marking it as protected or used).

notes: FUN_18095e290 sends it to a branch shared with MD 12389 (0x3065). Its destroy-S/T and banish-shuffle effects have no specific conditions here.

name: Link Spider

rules.when: Link Spider's effect Special Summons a Normal Monster
rules.prefer: Restrict placement to zones Link Spider points to (shared 'points-to' placement branch with Selene).

notes: Reaches the same placement case as Selene (0x33ca).
